tickets.title: Start retirement plan rollover
tickets.text: Start preparing the Silver Marmot Laboratories 401(k) move after separation, including receiving account registration and the company-stock portion. Nadia Copperwisp's 401(k) has about $914,000 with 38% in company stock, 52% in diversified equity funds, and 10% in stable value holdings.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2024-09-06 to start preparing the Silver Marmot Laboratories 401(k) move after separation, including receiving account registration and company-stock portion.

tickets.title: Review first-year retirement income and withholding
tickets.text: Review Nadia Copperwisp's first-year retirement income and withholding. Consider final paycheck, unused vacation payout, and first pension timing in the tax projection.
